seg.seg_note: STRUCTURE IN FORCE: two reportable segments 'Moody's Investors Service' (old MIS: four rating groups + Research, and ALL corporate expenses) and 'Moody's KMV' (MKMV). In this record mis_* = the OLD Moody's Investors Service segment (mis_lines = the four ratings lines plus 'Research revenue'; mis_ratings_total = ratings only) and ma_* = Moody's KMV (ma_lines = {'Moody's KMV'}). These are NOT comparable with the 2008+ MIS / MA segments: in January 2008 Research and MKMV were combined into Moody's Analytics, overhead/corporate costs were allocated by revenue split, an intersegment royalty (MIS revenue / MA expense) was introduced, and MIS lines were realigned (sovereign/sub-sovereign from FIG, infrastructure/utilities from CFG and project finance from SFG into new PPIF; REITs to SFG; Aug-2008 managed investments SFG->FIG). Reorganised (recast) figures are given in seg.legacy with labels starting 'Recast' and, for the prior year, in py. Inter-segment sales were 'insignificant' under the old structure (mis_interseg / elim null). Segment OI, D&A and restructuring: 10-K segment note (GAAP); no adjusted segment OI published. 2007 lines as originally reported (FY2007 release = FY2007 10-K Note 18). Reorganised 2007 figures: the FY2008 10-K / FY2008 release (incl. Aug-2008 managed-investments move SFG->FIG) are the basis used for 2008 py; an earlier first-cut recast (FY2007 release 'Summary Impact of Reorganization' and FY2007 10-K MD&A) and the FY2009 10-K recast (MA realigned to RD&A/RMS/PS; SF/CF re-split) are also in legacy. Recast segment OI 2007 (MIS 1,010.7 incl. 55.5 intersegment royalty revenue; MA 120.3) is identical in FY2007 10-K MD&A, FY2008 10-K and FY2009 10-K. US/international revenue from 10-K (release showed 1,361.4 / 897.6).
